evidence: GATE DIMENSIONS carry the real gate. tests/gates/render/judge.toml:15-23 (all_pass, one binary criterion hro_gate_render): incorrect password leaves visitor signed out, then correct Recruiter password signs in to 'a usable staff workspace with navigation and readable content ... A static picture or only a health response is insufficient' -> auth leg with positive control (render/prompt.md:9). tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:15-23 (all_pass, binary hro_gate_shared): Recruiter creates a job and a candidate through ordinary UI, then 'In a new independent empty browser context sign in as the Observer ... find that same job and exactly one card for that candidate in Applied ... A static seed response, a no-op success message, a browser-only save or a job-only app does not satisfy the gate' -> server-backing leg with independent-context readback, matching REVIEW_POLICY 'Gates must exclude convincing dead apps'. constraints/prompt.md:9 forbids API-only writes and defines a real independent context (new browser context, not reload/second tab). WIRING zeroes before shaping: scoring.toml:1-3 gates render/constraints at 0.0; score.py:41,48 gates_passed=all(score>0) else reward 0.0, returns 1 -> test.sh:217-220 exits before the scored suite. SCORED PROMPTS each restate an in-dimension gate under a 'Global browser gate' heading: functional/prompt.md:9-13 (same create + independent Observer readback; 'A blank or static shell, an unavailable app or an observed failure of that check gives every binary criterion 0'; all 43 functional criteria are binary), polish/prompt.md:9-12 ('binary0 throughout'; all 5 criteria binary), visual/prompt.md:9-12 ('minimum raw Likert score 1, which normalizes to zero'; all 5 criteria likert points=5). Verified that claim: tests/Dockerfile:31 pins harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7 and rewardkit 0.1.7 models.py:47 normalizes (raw-1)/(points-1), so raw 1 -> 0.0. No scored prompt grants partial credit on gate failure (the quality-checks.md #29 defect). Each scored gate includes the sign-in (auth) and server-backing legs, as the row requires when the app has them. NO SAME-ORIGIN requirement: case-insensitive grep for 'origin' over task/tests finds only functional/judge.toml:200 (unrelated stale-move criterion); no prompt requires same-origin assets or penalizes CDN; instruction.md:13 explicitly allows browser CDN fonts/scripts; task.toml network_mode = public at lines 22 and 38. Counterexample probes: (a) broken app that could pass - a client-only/localStorage app with hardcoded credentials passes render but fails constraints (the independent context cannot see a browser-only save); a static seeded board fails both (no-op create); a server-memory-only app passes the gates, but that is restart durability, graded in functional hro_restart and protected by the functional floor (scoring.toml:10-11), outside this row. (b) conforming app that could fail - an app requiring team/source fields still passes (the gate says 'any'; the judge fills required fields; hireops_rules.md:27-31 public); Observer read of the board is public (hireops_rules.md:18, app_context.md:16); stage name 'Applied' is public (hireops_rules.md:42). No conforming product found that fails the gates by text. Minor Notes (not defects): (1) the template's explicit sentence 'External font, script, or CDN asset requests are allowed and are not a failure' was dropped from all five task prompts; nothing requires same-origin and instruction.md:13 allows CDN, so Note-level only. (2) Each scored dimension repeats the full constraints-gate create/readback (extra judge work, not a correctness issue). (3) Constraints gate says 'exactly one card'; scored gates say 'the same candidate card' - consistent intent. RISK=true because gate behaviour is unmeasured: raw-evidence-index.json scope states 'Full configured grading/workload, reward discrimination/ranking and Oracle/target scores are absent'. No configured judge run shows the golden clearing both gates (including the browser_run_code_unsafe independent-context step under @playwright/mcp@0.0.79, tests/Dockerfile:19) or a blank/static-shell/browser-only weak app being hard-zeroed. Scripted golden observations (workspace.cjs/workspace.json, hashes verified) are not judge-gate evidence.
